SubscriptionPage.title: Subscription
SubscriptionPage.description: Choose the plan that fits you — the same full access to Polypips, with no feature locked behind a higher tier.

SubscriptionPlans.cancelledNotice: Your subscription is cancelled — access stays active until {date}.
SubscriptionPlans.cancelledNoticeFallback: the end of the paid period
SubscriptionPlans.activeNotice: You already have an active subscription. Choosing a plan below updates your current subscription (prorated).
